item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: Canapé 1.0.1
item.description:
Mac Transparent Glass Music Component

Canapé is a music playback control and desktop display tool for macOS. It allows you to place the Now Playing widget on your desktop or lock screen. With Canapé, you can control Spotify and Apple Music without leaving your current task. The desktop player supports skipping songs, dragging the progress bar, adding tracks to favorites, and customizing display buttons. You can also use two-finger gestures to resize the widget, switch songs, or tuck the widget away to either side of the screen. The interface offers transparent, translucent, and tinted glass effects that can be paired with different wallpapers. When a song is playing, Canapé automatically follows the corresponding music app and displays lyrics synchronized syllable by syllable. The player can also switch between audio output and AirPods mode, and supports features such as dynamic album covers, Last.fm, Discord, and lock screen wallpapers. Users can manage the desktop, status bar, and Now Playing feature switches from the menu bar; When using the Classic background, the software's CPU usage can be as low as 0%. Canapé is compatible with macOS 26.4 or later.

item.title: Charm 1.0.88
item.description:
macOS Grammar Auto-Correction Tool

Charm is a local AI English writing assistant for macOS that integrates spell correction, grammar fixes, and word prediction into your daily typing workflow. Spells quickly corrects spelling errors, Polish handles capitalization at the beginning of sentences, punctuation, apostrophes, and missing articles, and Oracle completes the current word and predicts the next word when you pause. Press Tab to accept the suggestion. The software supports both automatic and manual modes, allowing for independent configuration of features for different applications and websites. If you encounter a text box that does not support real-time editing, you can use keyboard shortcuts to modify the selected area or the entire input box as needed. The personal dictionary can store names, terms, and slang. Custom text replacement and quick emoji input can reduce repetitive actions, and accidental edits can be immediately undone. Both text processing and vocabulary learning are performed locally on the Mac. No input content is uploaded, and no account registration is required. After downloading the model, error correction and predictions can be done offline. Currently, American and British English are supported, and text in other languages can be set to remain unmodified. Requires a Mac with an M1 chip or newer, and macOS 14 Sonoma or later.

item.title: ChainYourMac 2.5.2
item.description:
macOS Scrolling Window Manager

ChainYourMac is a native scrolling tiling window manager for macOS that places application windows side by side in a horizontally extendable strip. When a new window is opened, other windows are not compressed, making it easy to maintain a stable layout across multiple tasks. Users can switch windows using keyboard shortcuts or three-finger and four-finger trackpad gestures, and the strip will scroll smoothly with the focus. The software supports window stacking, cross-application tab columns, preset widths, column pinning, drag-and-drop sorting, and window spacing adjustments. It allows you to pin chats or notes to one side of the screen while letting other windows continue to scroll. Each monitor and each desktop space retains an independent layout, supporting cross-screen window movement and restoring column order, width, and stacking status after a restart. For different applications, you can set floating rules or fixed positions, and there are options for a focus border, dimming of inactive windows, and mouse focus linkage. The native SwiftUI interface, paired with a Rust backend engine, applies settings instantly and supports automation via the command line, Raycast, and URL schemes.

item.title: iGroup 1.1
item.description:
Mac Window Tab Grouping

iGroup is a cross-app window tab management tool for macOS that combines the standard windows of apps such as Safari, Pages, Keynote, Finder, etc., into a shared tab bar, allowing different apps to be organized around the same task. Drag one window to the title bar of another window to group them. The windows within the group will move and resize simultaneously. Click on the tab or use a shortcut to switch between them. You can also drag a tab out to restore it as an independent window. The software supports saving combinations of applications and web pages as tab presets and reopening them via Spotlight, Launchpad, the Dock, or the desktop to quickly restore commonly used work environments. Automatic grouping can collapse existing and newly created windows of the same application. Combined with rules set by application and window title, it controls which windows are included in the group. The New Tab page integrates app search, preset searches, URL opening, and web searches. You can also use the Safari extension to add new web tabs to window groups. The interface offers four tab styles, size and color settings, and integrates with the Dock and Stage Manager. iGroup supports Simplified and Traditional Chinese, requires no account, does not track users, and stores groups and settings locally;

item.title: BX 1.5
item.description:
macOS File Access Permission Control

BX is an application sandbox launcher for macOS that allows Claude, VS Code, JetBrains IDE, Xcode, ChatGPT, and command-line tools, among others, to run in separate system sandboxes. This ensures they only access the project folders you explicitly allow, rather than automatically inheriting the current user's access permissions to passwords, emails, documents, and other files. It uses the sandboxing mechanism built into macOS and does not require virtual machines, containers, or additional background services, nor does it require modifications to the application itself. The application can still retain its original settings, login status, and extensions. You can select applications and folders for each launch configuration, view their readable, writable, and invisible content in the graphical interface, and adjust permissions at any time. BX also provides menu bar status prompts, a Dock icon with a protection icon, a command-line launch method, text rules that can be included in version control, and records of denied access to help troubleshoot why tools cannot read files. It is suitable for restricting access to local files by AI tools, third-party extensions, dependency installation scripts, and unfamiliar code repositories;

item.title: VirtualBuddy 2.2.1
item.description:
macOS Open Source Virtual Machine Program

VirtualBuddy is an open-source virtual machine management software for Macs with Apple silicon. It creates and runs macOS and ARM64 Linux virtual machines through a graphical interface, making it suitable for application compatibility verification, system testing, and beta testing. The software requires the host machine to be running macOS 14 Sonoma or later, and supports the installation of macOS 12 Monterey and later versions, as well as ARM64 Linux distributions such as Ubuntu Desktop and Ubuntu Server. The Installation Wizard supports downloading images from the system directory, entering custom download links, or importing local IPSW and ISO files, and displays the corresponding compatibility conditions. Each virtual machine can be independently configured with processor cores, memory, storage, display, and network. It supports macOS Recovery Mode, virtual machine cloning, and session saving and restoration for supported systems. Shared folders and clipboard functionality can be used with guest systems and VirtualBuddyGuest that meet the version requirements.

item.title: Flock 1.1.1
item.description:
Open-source, cross-platform PHP development environment

Flock is an open-source local development environment for PHP and Laravel projects. It supports macOS, Windows, and Linux, and runs PHP, Node.js, databases, and web servers through native processes without the need for Docker or virtual machines. The macOS version provides a menu bar application, and projects can also be managed via the command line. Once the project directory is hosted or linked, you will have access to an independent . Test domains and subdomains, and enable HTTPS without browser warnings. The software supports multiple versions of PHP 8.1 to 8.5 running in parallel, allowing each project to specify its own version. It can also configure Node.js based on the .nvmrc file. Built-in service management covers a wide range of database, caching, search, and object storage services, combined with application-based local email inboxes, making it easy to validate business processes. The debugging feature can collect variable outputs, queries, logs, and views upon request, and provide editor jumps and Xdebug that can be enabled on demand.

item.title: AloeNotch 0.16.0
item.description:
macOS Open Source Dynamic Island Tool

AloeNotch is an open-source macOS tool that transforms the MacBook notch area into an interactive panel. It normally blends into the notch in solid black and expands when hovered over or when a shortcut key is pressed. It centrally displays currently playing content such as Apple Music, Spotify, and browser videos, offering playback controls, progress scrubbing, synchronized lyrics, and real-time music spectrums, and can display edge lighting effects based on the cover color. The file shelf supports dragging files in, retaining them across launches, dragging them out to share, and right-clicking to compress and convert images. The clipboard can store the last 24 entries and supports searching, pinning, and copying with formatting or as plain text. The content is only retained in memory. The panel also integrates a timer, stopwatch, focus timer, 24-hour calendar, weather forecast, volume and brightness indicators, audio output switching, and always-on display control. Users can adjust the expansion animation and disable hover triggering in full-screen mode or in specific applications. It can also be used on screens without notches and in multi-monitor environments. The software does not include analytics tracking, does not require an account, and network functions can be disabled separately. Relevant permissions are requested as needed.

item.title: Karabiner-Elements 17.0.0
item.description:
macOS Keyboard Mapping Tool

Karabiner-Elements is a keyboard mapping and enhancement tool for macOS that allows users to modify keyboard mappings and create complex custom shortcuts. It is the successor to Karabiner, featuring a completely different design and offering improved performance and functionality. Karabiner-Elements allows users to modify keyboard mappings, which means that any key on the keyboard can be mapped to another key, or multiple keys can be combined into a single key. For example, you can map the Caps Lock key to the Esc key, the right Option key to the Control key, or the Fn key to the Command key. Karabiner-Elements allows users to create custom, complex keyboard shortcuts. You can create custom shortcuts by combining multiple keys into one key, or by binding a set of keys to certain functions.

item.title: LuLu 4.6.0
item.description:
Open-source lightweight firewall for macOS

LuLu is a free, open-source macOS firewall that blocks unknown outgoing connections until you explicitly approve them. It detects and stops unauthorized network connections, helping prevent malware and third-party apps from sending data to remote servers. Its design is simple and easy to use, with a small attack surface, and its source code is public on GitHub for transparency. It supports single-user installs and currently focuses on process-level network rules. It provides basic network monitoring rather than full self-protection, so determined targeted attacks may still bypass it.

item.title: DynamicNotch 1.6.5
item.description:
macOS Open Source Dynamic Island Enhancement Tool

DynamicNotch is a native macOS Dynamic Island and notch interaction tool that transforms the notch area at the top of the MacBook screen into a dynamic interface for displaying live activities, system status, and quick interactions. It supports controls for currently playing media, album covers, audio visualizations, and customization of the playback progress bar color. It can also display download progress, AirDrop, timers, screen recording indicators, Focus mode, and Personal Hotspot status. Additionally, it provides media and Live Activity interfaces on the lock screen. The software can display temporary status notifications for events such as charging, low battery, full battery, Bluetooth connection, Wi-Fi, and VPN, allowing users to stay informed about device changes in real time. In terms of interaction, it supports mouse dragging, trackpad swiping, vertical swiping to collapse and restore, and horizontal scrolling to close. Combined with adaptive rounded corners, blur effects, and physics-based spring animations, it presents stretching, compression, and elastic deformation. For MacBooks, iMacs, Mac minis, or external displays without a physical notch, the software can automatically adopt a floating capsule form. The project is open-source under the GPL v3 license and is suitable for users who want to view system updates in one place and enhance their desktop interaction experience.

item.title: HotkeyClash 0.9.5
item.description:
Mac Shortcut Conflict Detection

HotkeyClash is an open source macOS menu bar shortcut conflict detection tool that centrally scans the menu shortcuts of running applications, the configuration files of common automation tools, and system shortcuts to help identify which actions are occupied by the same key combination. It supports Karabiner-Elements, skhd, Keyboard Maestro, BetterTouchTool, Hammerspoon, and Alfred, and can read shortcuts related to Spotlight, Mission Control, screenshots, and Globe function keys. The software separates conflicts into identifying conflicts and potential conflicts, and prompts which operations are more likely to respond first based on the processing order of the driver layer, the event blocking layer, the system layer, the global shortcut key layer, and the application menu layer; When peer competition cannot be determined, it will not be forced to judge. The user can also actually press a key to check which app actually received the input. The interface adopts the two-column layout of the conflict list and detail panel. It supports searching and exporting Markdown reports by application, action or key combination, and the fixed panel makes it easy to modify the configuration.

item.title: Tinycast 0.17.0
item.description:
Native lightweight all-purpose starter

Tinycast is a native macOS launcher for daily high-frequency operations. Press the global shortcut key to call up the hover panel from any interface, and centralize the application launch, file retrieval, clipboard, calculation conversion, window management and system control into the same portal. The software is implemented with SwiftUI and AppKit. Zero third-party dependencies, no Electron, and no telemetry data are collected. The memory occupancy is usually controlled within 100MB. The launcher supports fuzzy search and favorite sticky. You can view running apps and exit single or all apps. You can also bind a dedicated hotkey for a specific app. Press it once to switch between focusing and hiding. File search directly reuses the system Spotlight, opening files and folders in the folder selected by the user without indexing them yourself. The dictionary function reads the native dictionary and instantly interprets the input entries. Clipboard history overwrites both text and images, allowing you to search and paste back into the app you just used. The calculator performs mathematical operations, unit conversions, and real-time currency-to-cryptocurrency conversions within the panel.

item.title: PureSnitch 0.2.4
item.description:
Open Source Mac Firewall

PureSnitch is an open-source application firewall and network monitoring tool for macOS. It features a native SwiftUI interface, providing a menu bar status, network monitor, rule manager, connection alerts, traffic graphs, and a map-style view, allowing users to intuitively understand which hosts their Mac is communicating with. It reads the connection status of nettop and lsof through a privileged helper process, communicates with the main application using XPC, and can load pfctl-based host-level IPv4, CIDR, and port blocking rules after the user actively enables Enforcement. The software emphasizes no telemetry, no account dependency, and no backend analytics SDK. Rules and connection history are stored in a restricted directory on the local machine. The current version supports experimental local DNS proxy, DNS over HTTPS upstream, built-in domain name blocklist, rule search, and start/stop management. However, it does not have the per-process kernel-level filtering capability found in the official release. It is suitable for Mac users who require auditable source code, visual observation of outbound connections, and cautious enablement of blocking rules.

item.title: Motrix 2.4.7
item.description:
Multi-Protocol Resource Download Tool

Motrix for Mac is an all-around download tool. Support HTTP download, FTP download, BT download, magnetic link download, Baidu net disk resource download. Motrix also uses "Aria 2" as the core, so the download speed, multi-threading and other capabilities are almost the same as other download tools.

item.title: AppPorts 2.4.0
item.description:
Mac Migration Assistant

AppPorts is an application migration and storage management tool designed specifically for macOS. Its core capability is to migrate large applications to an external hard drive or external storage with a single click, while retaining a minimal placeholder file locally, allowing the application to still appear in /Applications, Launchpad, and the macOS menu as before and launch normally. It employs an intelligent linking mechanism to minimize local disk usage while maintaining a consistent system experience. It also offers features such as automatic update protection, code signing management, detection of orphaned links after disconnecting external drives, automatic recovery from migration interruptions, and the ability to revert to local storage at any time. This makes it suitable for users who need to free up Mac storage space without disrupting their usage habits. AppPorts is an application migration and storage management tool for macOS. It can migrate large applications and data directories to external storage while minimizing the impact on the system user experience, and keep the local launch path consistent with the daily operating method.
